Common.footerNote: Encrypted in your browser. The server only stores ciphertext.
Common.footerSecurity: No accounts, no tracking, no plaintext.

Home.title: Share it once. Then it’s gone.
Home.description: Send a file or a note with end-to-end encryption, a password, an expiry time, and a view limit. The server never sees what you share.
Home.heroNote: Works without an account. Your key stays in the link.
Home.featureE2eeDesc: AES-256-GCM runs in your browser. The key never reaches the server.
Home.featureBurnDesc: Set one or a few views. The ciphertext is deleted as soon as access is used up.
Home.featurePasswordDesc: Argon2id protects the key. Wrong passwords do not use up a view.
Home.featureScheduleDesc: Choose when a share becomes available and when it disappears for good.
Home.howTitle: A quiet, careful way to share
Home.howDesc: Three steps. No account, no feed, no permanent copy on our side.
Home.how1Desc: Your browser creates a random key and encrypts every chunk of the file.
Home.how2Desc: The decryption key lives in the URL fragment, which browsers never send to the server.
Home.how3Desc: The recipient decrypts in their browser. Views and expiry are enforced by the server.
Home.trust1: Ciphertext, file size, and access counts
Home.trust2: Schedule, password presence, and view limit
Home.trust3: We cannot see file names, content, or keys
Home.trust4: We cannot recover a lost password or link
Home.ctaDesc: Create a share in a few seconds. Nothing to install.

Create.title: Create a private share
Create.subtitle: Everything is encrypted in this browser before it leaves your device.
Create.textHint: Markdown is supported. Up to 256 KiB.
Create.dropHint: or choose one from your device
Create.accessLinkHint: The decryption key is part of the link. Send it through a trusted channel.
Create.accessPasswordHint: The link alone is not enough. Share the password separately.
Create.passwordHint: The password never leaves your browser. If you lose it, the share cannot be recovered.
Create.securityHint: The link is a secret. Anyone who has it can open the share, unless you set a password.
Create.uploadFailed: The upload stopped before it finished.
Create.resultDesc: Send the link securely. It only works once the share is opened in a browser.
Create.qrHint: The QR code contains the decryption key. Treat it like the link.
Create.inviteWithoutPassword:
Here is a private share: {link}
The link contains the decryption key, so only send it to someone you trust.
Create.warningLink: The link contains the decryption key. Anyone with it can read the content.
Create.warningPassword: Send the password through a different channel than the link.
Create.warningNoRecovery: There is no password reset. Losing the link or password means losing the content.
Create.warningBurn: If this is a one-time share, opening it will use up its only view.
Create.warningServer: The server stores ciphertext only, but it can still see when and how often this share is opened.
Create.savedLocally: A management entry was saved in this browser.
Create.emptyText: Write a note before creating the share.
Create.tooLarge: That file is larger than the {size} limit.
Create.invalidSchedule: The expiry time must be after the start time.
Create.invalidStart: The start time must be in the future.
Create.invalidExpiry: The expiry time must be in the future.
Create.invalidViews: Enter a view count between 1 and 100000.

Share.notFoundDesc: The link may be incomplete or the share may have been deleted.
Share.expiredDesc: The time window has closed and the ciphertext has been removed.
Share.revokedDesc: The creator removed it, so there is nothing left to open.
Share.exhaustedTitle: This share has been used up
Share.exhaustedDesc: Every allowed view has been used. The ciphertext is gone.
Share.burnedDesc: This share allowed a limited number of views and is now gone.
Share.scheduledDesc: The creator scheduled this share to start later.
Share.remainingViews: {count, plural, =0 {No views left} one {# view left} other {# views left}}
Share.passwordDesc: Enter the password the creator sent you. It is checked in your browser and on the server, but never stored.
Share.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
Share.keyMissingDesc: Open the full share link, including the part after the # symbol. If the creator set a password, ask them for it.
Share.corruptTitle: This share could not be decrypted
Share.corruptDesc: The data failed its integrity check. It may have been damaged or tampered with.
Share.downloadHint: The file is decrypted locally. The server only sent ciphertext.
Share.downloadFailed: The download could not be completed.
Share.unsupportedTitle: This browser cannot stream large files
Share.unsupportedDesc: Use a Chromium-based browser such as Chrome or Edge for large files. Smaller files can still be decrypted in memory.
Share.textDesc: The note is decrypted only in your browser. It is never rendered on the server.
Share.viewOnceWarning: Opening this note will use up a view. If it is a one-time share, it cannot be opened again.
Share.markdownHint: Rendered locally from the decrypted Markdown source.
Share.clearKeyHint: This keeps the decrypted content open, but a refresh will need the original link again.
Share.clearedKey: Key removed from the address bar
Share.securityNote: End-to-end encrypted. The creator cannot recover a lost password or link.
Share.localTime: Times are shown in your local time zone.
Share.viewAgainHint: This share has more views left. Opening it again will use another one.
Share.keyMissingTelegramDesc: This Mini App link does not include the decryption key. Use the original share link from the creator.

Manage.title: My shares
Manage.subtitle: Management tokens are stored only in this browser. Clearing site data removes this list.
Manage.emptyDesc: Create a share and it will appear here. You can revoke it or copy its link later.
Manage.importDesc: Paste a management link created on another device to add it to this list.
Manage.importInvalid: That management link is not valid.
Manage.revokeDesc: The link will stop working and the ciphertext will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
Manage.clearDesc: This only removes the management entries stored here. The shares themselves stay online.
Manage.invalidToken: The management token is no longer valid.
Manage.linkMissingKey: The link key was not stored for this share.
Manage.keyWarning: Links copied from here contain the decryption key.
Manage.telegramDesc: Shares created while signed in with Telegram. Link keys stay on the device that created them.
Manage.telegramAdoptHint: Attach the shares stored in this browser to your Telegram account so you can manage them on other devices. Link keys stay on this device.
